fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-html) spread the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block verbatim (headline, description, datePublished, dateModified, author, publisher, image, url, mainEntityOfPage, copyrightYear) but that block carries no articleBody, so articleBody is scraped separately from div.story__content paragraphs and added on top. Latest-mode records (S2-sitemap) come from the Google-News-flavored XML sitemap at /feeds/sitemap (brecorder.com has no RSS/Atom feed) -- only title/link/publicationDate/language, re-sorted newest-first by the numeric article ID in the URL since sitemap order isn't strictly chronological. Upstream JSON-LD is passed through close to verbatim, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest'/'latest:<section>') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-html or S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle; HTML entities unescaped).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, scraped separately from div.story__content > p paragraphs (not present in the JSON-LD block).

author.title: Author
author.description: List of Person objects as emitted by upstream JSON-LD (raw passthrough).

url.title: URL
url.description: Canonical article URL, as emitted upstream.

title.title: Title
title.description: Article title from the sitemap's news:title field (latest mode).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, from the sitemap's <loc> (latest mode).

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Date-only publish date from the sitemap's news:publication_date field, no time component (latest mode).

language.title: Language
language.description: Article language code from the sitemap's news:language field (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
